subject: MEASURE-SHADOW-ORCHESTRATOR 8fe2168: apparatus exists, no live ShadowSignal score yet
body:
packages/prediction-engine/src/pipeline/orchestrator-climatology-skill.ts

Named baseline: home-win indifference p=0.5. Kill line pre-registered:
BSS <= 0 at n >= 100 is a kill; n < 100 is underpowered. Expanding-window
home-win rate is a diagnostic only — on a walk-forward prefix it can lose
to the dummy, so it is not the kill.

No market term. evaluateGame is not used (it requires marketHomeProb).
Protocol is predictStates → predictHomeWinProbability → settleGame.

What this is NOT: a score on production ShadowSignal rows. That needs the
capture plane (flash). What it IS: the rung-2 instrument the shadow pass
has been missing, with a kill line, on a synthetic strength DGP that
proves the filter beats the 0.5 dummy and an oracle survives.

Next: register this trial in trials-registry (never run) so the loop
actually records a hash-chained result. Not spatial. Not Venn-Abers rebuild.
